name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $3,519 on 20 Nov after an 8.7% weekly fall, beyond the 7% weekly Alert line; down 25% in three months
state: Gold futures were near $3,519 early on 20 Nov, 8.7% lower on the week and 25% lower over three months, past the 7% single-week Alert line; the price is a third below its 52-week high of $5,318 (Yahoo Finance). Spot gold fell 2.7% on 19 Nov to a 14-month low as markets priced a December Fed rate rise and the dollar neared a 19-month high; the Gulf conflict brought no sustained safe-haven buying (Kitco).
for_you: Gold is in a disorderly sell-off driven by rising interest rates and a strong dollar. Holders of gold and gold-linked funds face large swings; the move reflects rate expectations, not easing geopolitical risk.
rubric_hit: Alert: single-week move -8.7% exceeds the 7% line; 3-month fall 25%

sources.title: Kitco — Gold falls below $3,650, silver tumbles as Fed rate concerns pressure metals

why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
